messages:
maria: follow-up from RFC: we need a compact wire representation for pin/rollout metadata that scales across millions of requests. Goals: minimal bytes, clear defaults for old clients, and full fidelity in control-plane/UI.

sam: agreed. two big risks: 1) ambiguous short keys in logs/alerts, 2) different runtimes parsing slightly different semantics. need explicit parse rules.

kai: sketch of compact schema: short keys only on the wire, expanded mapping in control-plane. suggestion: 
- p = pin (hard | soft | optional)
- t = type (model | variant | tenant) 
- l = lease expiration (RFC3339)
- v = version id (content hash or semver)
- o = origin (service:id)
- m = metadata hints (array)
- sv = schema_version (int)
Example: 
```
{"p":"hard","t":"model","v":"m-20260803-ff3a","l":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z","o":"rollout-svc:v2","m":["canary","low-io"],"sv":3}
```

rachel: UX note: when this hits Console or logs, we MUST expand keys immediately for human readability. Devs will not memorize single-letter fields. Also add an `audit` token on control-plane side to link actions back to user ids.

maria: good call. on compatibility: servers MUST treat unknown fields as ignorable. Clients SHOULD tolerate missing fields and use defaults: p=soft, l=null (no expiry), sv=1 if absent. Also: if `v` is present and `t` omitted, assume t=model for backward compat.

kai: runtime helper plan: provide small parsers in Go, Python, and Rust that accept both compact and expanded forms. Parsers should emit a canonical expanded map for downstream systems.

sam: tenant overrides: acceptable shape is an optional `overrides` list in the expanded control-plane. On the wire we keep it out of hot path; dedicated control-plane-only endpoints will accept expanded JSON for administrative actions. So runtime requests stay compact.

rachel: telemetry: recommend `obs` short field to show which infra observed the pin (e.g., edge-proxy, placement-engine). It's small and useful for debugging.

ops-bot: created INF-1278 (compat tests) and RFC-2203 (schema doc) tickets.

maria: decision: adopt compact single-character wire keys for hot-path RPCs, require `sv` >= 2 for new features, ignore unknown fields for forward compat, provide control-plane-expanded payloads for UI/admin flows, and produce parser libs for runtimes.

Action items:
- sam: author updated RFC and compatibility matrix (due Tue next week)
- kai: implement parser libs + unit tests (PR: incoming)
- rachel: Console expansion mapping + logging helper (will prototype)
- maria: add schema migration notes and rollout checklist.

sam: draft link for RFC: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/10042 (WIP)

rachel: will ping infra for observability hooks once mock is ready.

maria: thanks folks  :thumbsup: finish up in next sync and we'll merge serializer changes into runtime branch.
